description: This file contains shell functions used for managing boot configuration and upgrade procedures on Qualcomm-based embedded devices. It includes functions to find boot entries, read and write boot configuration indices, determine the next root filesystem partition, and prepare for device upgrade.

methods.name: bootconfig_find_entry
methods.description: Finds the offset of a specified partition entry within a boot configuration binary file.

methods.name: bootconfig_rw_index
methods.description: Reads or writes the index of a specified boot entry in a boot configuration partition.

methods.name: smempart_next_root
methods.description: Determines the next active root filesystem partition based on current partition offsets.

methods.name: elecom_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares device for upgrade by reading current boot configuration and determining the next root partition.
